messages:
jess: FYI customer (acme-ads) just escalated — lots of 504s from hosted inference during a traffic ramp, started ~2026-03-17 09:12 PST. Ticket INC-4567.

riley: seeing the same alerts in prod — spike in queue length + gateway 504s. Looks like scaleup lag.

marco: quick glance at autoscaler: KEDA scaled pods from 0 -> 12 in ~40s but HPA stayed at 2-3 for same window. possible config mismatch between ScaledObject and HPA.

riley: logs pulled from controller: `ScaledObject acme-worker paused due to annotation autoscaler.keda.sh/paused=true` — we have a paused annotation on some tenants from last week's routing experiment.

zara: can you paste the ScaledObject/HPA outputs?

riley: pasted outputs below:
```
kubectl get scaledobject acme-worker -n prod -o yaml
# ... annotations: autoscaler.keda.sh/paused: "true"

kubectl get hpa acme-worker -n prod
NAME         REFERENCE         TARGETS    MINPODS MAXPODS REPLICAS
acme-worker  Deployment/acme  80%/100%   2       20      3
```

Note: model init logs show cold start ~25-30s to pull weights + 15s to warm KV cache.

tony: customer SLA breach — escalating to P1. @oncall-bot can you create an incident? :rotating_light:

oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2026-789. Paging eng-sre and eng-runtime.

marco: repro steps I've been running (local):
```
ab -n 500 -c 50 https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate?tenant=acme
# result: ~30-40% 504s when pod pool is cold
```

riley: hypothesis: combination of paused ScaledObject + low HPA minReplicas + long model init (warmup) -> requests hit gateway timeout before new pods become ready. KEDA wakes faster but HPA floor prevents immediate pod count. Also probe parallelism causes sockets to queue.

zara: short-term mitigation options:
- remove paused annotation from ScaledObject for acme
- bump HPA minReplicas to 4 for acme-worker
- temporarily increase gateway upstream timeout to 90s for that route
- enable deployment prewarm (init container) for large models
Which should we run now?

marco: I'm going to remove the paused annotation and patch HPA minReplicas (canary in prod-shared). Commands: 
```
kubectl patch scaledobject acme-worker -n prod -p '{"metadata":{"annotations":{"autoscaler.keda.sh/paused":"false"}}}' --type=merge
kubectl patch hpa acme-worker -n prod -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":4}}'
```

jess: upstream gateway change needs ops approval; oncall, please approve temporary timeout bump while we verify fixes.

oncall-bot: Ops approval requested for gateway timeout change (INC-2026-789).

tonny: (ops) approved, rolling 90s timeout to canary for tenant route.

riley: rolling patches now — removing pause + HPA bump applied to canary subset. Observing pod creation + readiness.

jess: customer replied asking for ETA on mitigation to share with customer success.

riley: 504s dropped to normal after changes at ~2026-03-17 09:46 PST. Increased minReplicas prevented next coldstart gap, and removing pause allowed KEDA to control bursts. Will monitor 2 hours. :white_check_mark:

zara: followups: audit why paused annotation was left on for tenants after experiment; add a guard in deploy pipeline to prevent annotated paused:true on production ScaledObjects; add a warmup preflight option for models > XGB.

jess: thanks all — I'll update INC-4567 with repro, root cause (paused ScaledObject + HPA floor + model warmup), mitigations taken, and next steps.

riley: last note: add a dashboard alert for "scaledobject paused + request backlog > 50" so we catch this before customer impact.
